verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing claims "granular user permissions" alongside card limits and spend controls, and says built-in permissions let an accountant make payments. Payment approvals can follow organization approval policies, so team-member-level permissioning exists in some form. However, the evidence is only marketing-level, with no documentation of role definitions or permission scopes. Missing for 10: documented custom role definitions and permission matrix, scoping permissions by location or department, in-depth first-party docs on user management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
